title: OSPF vs EIGRP: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Do you navigate by G P S or by local landmarks? O S P F gives every router the full map. E I G R P trusts what its neighbours say.

scenes.heading: Side by side
scenes.narration: Here's the comparison. O S P F is link state, and E I G R P is advanced distance vector. O S P F uses cost, and E I G R P uses bandwidth and delay. O S P F is one ten, and E I G R P is ninety, or one seventy external. O S P F needs area zero, and E I G R P has no areas.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. E I G R P is not link state. O S P F uses cost. Auto summary is off on modern I O S.

items.right: Off by default in modern IOS

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva OSPF vs EIGRP lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. O S P F is link state, and E I G R P is advanced distance vector. Distances: one ten, ninety and one seventy. Only E I G R P is Cisco's own, by origin. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva OSPF vs EIGRP lab.

points.t: OSPF: link-state. EIGRP: advanced distance vector
EIGRP is Cisco origin; OSPF is open
